definitions: A chess piece of the smallest size and value. Each player has eight pawns at the start of a game.
A person used by others for their own purposes.
The state of being pledged as security for a loan.
An object left as security for a loan, especially with a pawnbroker.
examples: He sacrificed a pawn to gain a better position.
She felt like a pawn in their political game.
He retrieved his pawn from the shop.
